prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. Shelves and merchandise are farther behind and to the left of the person, approximately 1–3 m from the camera, and another person is only partly visible at the far right edge in some frames. The person across the counter faces generally toward the camera wearer, with one arm extending over the counter; their gaze cannot be determined because their face is out of view. The register, near counter edge, and payment area are within the camera wearer’s arm’s reach, while the paper bag and register are within the other person’s reach; the register and counter partially occlude their lower body. Across the five frames, the viewpoint shifts closer and slightly rightward toward the register and payment area, making these objects and the person’s torso appear larger while the left-side shelves move partly out of view.
